info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Regions API

params.name: regions
params.description: This parameter is used to only get regions in the list provided. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of Region IDs.

params.name: name
params.description:
This parameter is used to only get specific regions by name. This parameter expects a string- the full name of a region
 or partial name with the wildcard %.

params.name: cursor
params.description:
This parameter is a cursor that selects what regionID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 137 here will only get you regions
 with an id greater than 137.

params.name: limit
params.description:
This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 
results at one time.

items.docs:
This request returns your Regions in Limble. 

Return data description

Property: regionID, Description: The ID of the Region
Property: regionName, Description: The name of the Region
Property: parentRegionID, Description: The regionID of the parent of a region.

Creates a region.

Parameters:

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| name | body | string | yes |  | Region name |
| parentRegionID | body | integer | no | 0 | Parent region (≥ 0) |

Responses:
- 201 Created: { regionID } with Location header.

Updates a region.

Parameters:

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| regionID | path | integer | yes |  | Region identifier |
| name | body | string | no |  | New name |
| parentRegionID | body | integer | no |  | New parent (≥ 1) |

Deletes a region.

Parameters:

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| regionID | path | integer | yes |  | Region identifier |

Responses:
- 200 OK: Deleted.
- 404 Not Found: Region does not exist.
